commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS comparison worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 1
systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
